name: InvexaRetail
install: cd api && npm install && cd ../web && npm install

terminals.name: api
terminals.description: Retail Inventory API (Express + Prisma). Leave DATABASE_URL unset so the API uses in-memory seed data (no MySQL required). Listens on http://localhost:4000. Seeds demo accounts (admin@retail.local / ChangeMe123!).
terminals.command: cd api && NODE_ENV=development PORT=4000 ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:4000 JWT_SECRET=dev-secret-change-in-production SEED_PASSWORD=ChangeMe123! STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_invexa_local STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_invexa_local ENABLE_DEV_OTP=true node dist/index.js

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: React + Vite web portal. Points VITE_API_BASE at the local API. Serves http://localhost:5173.
terminals.command: cd web && VITE_API_BASE=http://localhost:4000 npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0
